name: Boku no H na Natsu no Omoide ~Onee-chan-tachi to Sugoshita Hachigatsu~
original_name: ボクのHな夏の思い出～お姉ちゃん達と過ごした八月～
source:
While riding in your family's car, you came upon a rural village filled with greenery.

You were dropped off to live with two Oneechans in a lovely country home.

Experience new freedoms for the first time with two excitable sisters who will give you unbelievable hospitality.

The refreshing landscape, the sweet smell of fresh air, shades of green, and the erotic taste of the villages' fruits all await you.

This will be an unforgettable summer vacation.

[From Steam (Page removed)]
